title: Bartsch to Müller, 3 September 1631
author: Jacob Bartsch
source: Jacob Bartsch's letter to Philipp Müller written at Lauban on 3 September 1631, on the eve of setting out with Kepler's widow for Prague, Regensburg, Linz and Vienna, with instructions for his tables, the *Ephemerides* and the *Somnium*. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 10. J. 11). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 105.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Setting out with Kepler's widow for Prague, Regensburg, Linz and Vienna, Bartsch leaves instructions for selling the tables, *Ephemerides* and *Somnium*.
